A baker shares recipes from his new cookbook

The baker joined the show on Tuesday to talk about his new cookbook and shared two recipes from it, a lemon loaf and a chocolate tart that he says anyone can make at home.

For the lemon loaf, cream the butter and sugar, add the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour and the zest of two lemons. Bake for fifty minutes.

The tart uses a press-in crust, so there is no rolling. Chill the filling for at least four hours before you slice it, and serve it with whipped cream.
